findings: All ten local afterimages match their exact remotely fetched Git blobs, and the two untruncated complete source trees differ in exactly the declared ten fixture/control paths.

The new gate only reads already retained callback/receipt evidence after the unchanged original delivery checks, route metrics and receipt reconciliation. Removing its single import and call block restores the previous entry byte-for-byte; the old source-test helper changes only Any import/return annotation.

Original ordering remains five Pi and five OMP callbacks, with an exact offered/returned pair per case. Missing, extra, reordered or partial callback populations fail. There is no extra callback, daemon request, native evaluation, retry or timing population.

All original delivery decisions, HTTP status/path/method, model output hashes, preserved/blocked behavior and source reason codes are validated again without weaker expectations. The new gate expressly forbids the older plaintext alternative for each of the six PostToolUse cases.

Each encrypted post requires HTTP encrypted-reference presence, exact ciphertext digest equality with the frozen native-entry projection, native source_payload_kind encrypted_payload_ref, and the matching receipt payload kind. A complete reconciled witness and full receipt-to-committed-row equality are mandatory.

All ten decision IDs must be present, nonempty and distinct. The existing witness independently retains real writer admission, exact full SQL receipt equality, request/correlation/source proof, compact ACK generation/policy/runtime/mode join and the separately admitted installed rule digest. No absent rule field is inferred from the compact ACK.

Seventeen new modeled-evidence controls cover unchanged successful evidence, plaintext substitutions, wrong ciphertext, missing/extra callbacks, duplicate/missing/uncommitted receipts, false/incomplete checks, offer membership, original verdict/output/privacy violations and population change. They explicitly do not supply actual installed receipt evidence.
limits: Source-only peer: no product code, source tests, native builds, installed probes, or workload executed by peer; no refs changed.
Fresh current-package artifact admission and exact operational driver are separate, currently ready=false. No installed ten-callback success is inferred from modeled source controls.

Selected installed scope is three POSIX platforms. Windows encrypted references remain explicitly unsupported, and the current Windows default-auto failure and strict quartet artifact gap remain separate facts.
No full RSP136, RSP140, external host-application, native approval consumption, timing or release qualification is granted.
